dashboard.title: Rotation Account Management
dashboard.description: Manage intermediate accounts that switch on a cycle (monthly / quarterly / any): channel-payable, channel-receivable, user-suspense, etc. Click <1>logical_account_key</1> to see the detail page and check whether each historical instance's balance is zero.
dashboard.infoTooltip: The rotation feature is delivered by 4 cooperating jobs in accounting-system: Scheduler + Convergence + Migration + Audit. This page is backed by service.AdminService (rotation_admin_service.go).

manualOp.switchAlert: This will immediately move the current active instance to draining and promote the provisioned instance to active.
manualOp.provisionAlert: This will immediately create the next period's provisioned instance (without switching the active one).
manualOp.operatorRequired: Required, recorded in the audit log
manualOp.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. fault drill / early end-of-month switch / balance anomaly under review
manualOp.reasonRequired: Required, recorded in the audit log

register.title: Create LogicalAccount
register.alert: An LA is the stable account key on the business side; multiple instances rotate behind it on a cycle. After registration status=enabled; if rotation_enabled=true, also click Provision + Switch Now to start the first active instance.
register.suffixRequired: Please fill in the logical_account_key suffix
register.keyLengthError: Full key length must be in [8, 64]: current {{length}}
register.operatorRequired: Required, written to registered_by for audit
register.fullKeyHelp: Concatenation: prefix + suffix. Total length in [8, 64], ASCII printable (no spaces).
register.businessTypeRequiredMsg: Required; for a new channel register it on the Business Type Management page first
register.businessTypeTooltip: account_type / category are derived from business_type to avoid manual mistakes. To add a new channel, go through the Business Type Management registration flow.
register.businessTypePlaceholder: Select a registered business_type; account type / accounting category will be derived automatically
register.rotationEnabledTooltip: false → single-instance compatibility mode; true → rotation enabled, you can click Provision / Switch Now.
register.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Alipay channel payable main account

detail.description: Status + balance for all instances (including archived) under this logical_account. The <1>balance</1> of archived instances must be 0 (invariant I4); a green "0" tag marks them here.
detail.rotationDisabledTitle: This logical_account does not have rotation enabled
detail.rotationDisabledDesc: rotation_enabled = false; the account runs in legacy mode with a single permanently-active instance.
detail.nonZeroTitle: Non-active instances with non-zero balance exist
detail.nonZeroDesc: Archived / frozen instances should have balance = 0; if they stay non-zero for long, check the Convergence Job / Migration Job logs.

test.pageDescription: In fleet mode, a Logical Account is backed by 100 sub-accounts (sharded across 100 shards by user_id 0-99); the booking router uses <1>fnv32a(flow_id) % 100</1> to pick which sub takes the traffic. This page provides two tools - <3>Resolve</3> (see which sub the routing hits) and <5>Book</5> (run an end-to-end booking to validate the link).

resolve.title: 1. Fleet Routing Resolution
resolve.description: Given LA key + flow_id, this replicates the fleet routing algorithm in <1>rotation_router.go</1> and returns the selected sub-account (for troubleshooting / demo). The same flow_id always hits the same sub_idx (idempotent).
resolve.flowIdTooltip: Any string; hashed to pick a sub. Same flow_id routes to the same sub_idx.

book.title: 2. Fleet End-to-End Booking Demo
book.alertDesc1: The source account uses fleet routing (we recommend filling <1>src_logical_account_key</1>); the destination is given by account_no directly. Production callers should use the gRPC <3>CreateTransaction</3>; this endpoint is only for ops to validate the fleet link.
book.alertDesc2: The amount flows from src (Debit) to dst (Credit); the src balance decreases and the dst balance increases.
book.srcLogicalAccountKeyTooltip: With LA key + flow_id we can auto-select a sub-account inside the fleet.
book.srcAccountNoPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the LA key
book.srcAccountNoTooltip: Specify the source account number directly; filled in means no routing.
book.dstAccountNoRequired: Required; must be an existing account
book.flowIdTooltip: Repeated calls with the same flow_id are idempotent; its hash also decides which sub src picks.
book.srcResolutionTitle: Source Sub-account Hit by Fleet Routing
book.srcDebitedMessage: src account has been debited <1>{{amount}}</1> to reach the current balance; click <3>LA Detail</3> to see the full fleet sub distribution.
